theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The problem statement explicitly dictates a dark `#050510` background, a neon gradient palette, 3D glowing blocks, and high-energy particle effects. Archetype 7 perfectly captures this arcade/cyberpunk vibe.

headings.usage: Score, Combo popups, Modal Titles, Season Pass upsell.

body.usage: Button labels, daily rewards text, standard UI copy.

rules.capitalization: All action buttons and overlines must be UPPERCASE.
rules.glow: Combo texts must have a drop-shadow matching the combo block color to simulate neon glow.

screen_constraints.alignment: center (for larger screens, confine to centered 430px column)

skyline_scene.day_night_cycle: Subtle opacity crossfade between a warm #ffbe0b radial sun and a cool #3a86ff moon behind the buildings.
skyline_scene.buildings: 6 SVG vectors, initially grayscale/dim (opacity: 0.3). Unlock thresholds: 5, 12, 20, 28, 38, 48 lines. On unlock: Transition to full neon gradient fill + heavy drop-shadow glow.

animations_and_juice.line_clear: White flash (0.1s) -> Scale row/col down to 0 -> Trigger particle burst -> Screen shake (intensity based on combo level).
animations_and_juice.danger_overlay: Pulsing inset red shadow (`box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px #ff0033`) when grid > 75% full.

interactions_and_haptics.dragging: Spawn 3D ghost under finger, offset Y by -40px so finger doesn't obscure piece.
interactions_and_haptics.hover_valid: Ghost glows GREEN + Light Haptic impact.

monetization_ui.top_bar: Sticky header. Left: Score. Center: Streak (Flame Icon). Right: Coins. Below: Energy Bar (5/5 cells, segmented).

modals.game_over: Title: 'Grid Locked'. Buttons: 'Watch Ad (Green, pulsating)', 'Continue (Cyan)', 'Buy Pass (Gold)', 'Restart (Gray)'.
modals.season_pass: Aggressive but premium. Large header image, scrolling list of rewards. CTA: '$4.99/mo' bouncing slightly.

urls.description: 3D glowing magenta gems for IAP shop bundles.
3D glowing gold coins for IAP shop bundles.
Sci-fi neon loot crate for 7-day calendar.
Futuristic cyberpunk banner for Season Pass modal.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (tray pieces, buttons, undo, shop items, settings toggles) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="undo-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the core grid logic using an 8x10 matrix in standard React state or Zustand.
Use react-native-reanimated and react-native-gesture-handler to build the drag-and-drop system. Ensure the 'ghost' piece renders properly in the portal/root so it's not clipped by containers.
Implement the 3D block styling using overlapping Views with absolute positioning, inner shadows, and bottom borders to simulate a deep bevel.
Construct the SVG skyline with 6 distinct building paths. Tie their fill opacity to a derived state based on total cleared lines.
Add expo-haptics and expo-av for all requested feedback points (hover, drop, clear).
Ensure all UI modals (Grid Locked, Shop, Season Pass, Daily Rewards) are styled as premium glassmorphic overlays with neon borders.
Implement exact Media URLs for the monetization modals as defined in the media section. Do NOT use placeholder images.
